attributes.title: Level 8

subgroups.name: Discover

steps.text: Watch this video to learn about how to create custom tile assets to design engaging tilemaps in your projects!

questions.hint: What else could be down to create a more cohesive design, with the tiles already on the tilemap?
questions.title: [Select all that apply] What might enhance this tilemap’s design?

answers.text: Filling in the all of the empty space with extra tiles
Removing all of the tiles from the tilemap

questions.correctResponse: Solid and corner tiles help blend the tiles together to smooth outlines and create a more cohesive tilemap design.

questions.hint: Which function matches a tile at a certain direction from the sprite?
questions.title: [Select one] What function should be used to check if a tile, in a certain direction from a sprite, matches a specific tile image?
questions.correctResponse: The tileKindAt function can be useful to regulate sprite movement on a tilemap! It can only climb up if overlapping a ladder tile at its center.

questions.hint: How many dimensions should be visible in each type of tile asset?
questions.title: [Match one per answer] Match the qualities of the 2D and 3D tile assets:

statements.text: The user can see the length, width, and height of a tile structure.
The user can only see a top and bottom layer of a tile structure.

questions.correctResponse: 2D and 3D tile assets should be designed to show the perspective that the user has in the project (from the side versus from above).

questions.title: [Open response] What types of tiles will you include in your tile pack?
questions.correctResponse: Those sound like great ideas! Looking forward to seeing what you create in your custom tile pack!

subgroups.title: Custom Tile Assets
subgroups.introduction: Watch this video to learn about how to create custom tile assets to design engaging tilemaps in your projects!

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 8 of Brown Belt! In this level, you’ll learn more about creating original tile assets to build unique tilemaps. Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 8:

badges.title: Mapping It Out
badges.description: Use a variety of pixel art techniques to create original tile assets that can be used for top-down or 2D tilemaps.

badges.title: A Whole New World
badges.description: Create original tile assets, including ground terrain and floating platform tiles, that can be used to design a 2D tilemap.

badges.title: Open Concept
badges.description: Create original tile assets that can be combined in a variety of ways to design structures that span multiple tiles.

badges.title: Changing It Up
badges.description: Change a sprite’s movement ability based on its location in relation to a specific tile kind.
